app.name: AnyLearn
app.tagline: Learn from your own documents, with your own AI.

sources.title: Sources
sources.empty: Nothing is cited yet. When an answer quotes one of your documents, the passage and its page number appear here, so you can check the claim against the original instead of trusting the summary.

margin.title: In the margin
margin.read: A document is read once and cut into passages. Those passages are all AnyLearn ever quotes back to you, each with its page, so any claim can be checked against the original.
margin.practise: A point you get wrong comes back the same day. A point you know comes back just before you would forget it. Mastery is counted from answers, never from time spent.
margin.reflect: Five minutes to start, fourteen days to test one change, ninety days to decide whether to keep it. The loop only moves on evidence you have already recorded.
margin.body: Regular exercise supports focus and memory. Targets come from what you logged last time, never from a guess, and a missed session simply waits.
margin.home: AnyLearn runs on your own AI accounts and answers only from documents you give it. Nothing here is a plan or a credit balance.

home.lead: Choose one thing to do first, then decide how far to go.
home.body: Every answer it does give carries the passage it came from, down to the page. The same rule holds for progress later on: a quiz result, a mastery level or a finished cycle has to point at the work that earned it.

functionHelp.chat: Answers questions from your documents, with citations.
functionHelp.parse: Turns an uploaded PDF into text AnyLearn can quote, page by page.
functionHelp.embed: Turns your documents into vectors so they can be searched. Changing the model here means re-indexing.
functionHelp.quiz: Writes questions with answers and explanations.
functionHelp.mastery: Builds and scores the mastery path.
functionHelp.solve: Works a problem step by step.

Optional: an OpenAI key (whisper-1), a Groq key (whisper-large-v3-turbo, or whisper-large-v3), your own OpenAI-compatible Whisper server (name its model), or a Gemini key, which reads a public YouTube video's URL. The server's built-in engine, when it runs one, needs no key.

search.lead: Research can read the web as well as your documents, using a search key of your own. There is no shared key: without one, research still works; it just answers from your documents only. An OpenAlex key is optional and only for scholarly papers: without one, AnyLearn uses OpenAlex's free daily allowance, shared by everyone on this server.
search.empty: No search key. Research runs against your own documents only.

experimental.title: Experimental subscription lanes
experimental.warning: These lanes are unofficial. They make AnyLearn sign in as software the provider made for your own machine (the ChatGPT and Codex CLI, VS Code's Copilot extension, Claude Code, the Gemini tools), which none of OpenAI, GitHub, Anthropic or Google licenses for use through another app. Your account may be restricted or closed as a result. The Gemini lane also asks for broad Google Cloud access, so the token stored here can reach far more than AI. An ordinary API key is the reliable choice; use these only if you accept that.

chatgpt.title: ChatGPT subscription (relay)
chatgpt.body: AnyLearn cannot sign you in to ChatGPT: that sign-in only completes on your own computer. Obtain the tokens yourself and paste them here. AnyLearn will store them encrypted and renew them.
chatgpt.expiresIn: Seconds until the access token expires

gemini.title: Gemini Code Assist
gemini.body: Two steps. Enter a redirect address registered with this deployment's Google OAuth client to get a consent link, then paste the authorisation code Google gives you. This also needs a Google account that has a Code Assist tier.
gemini.openConsent: Open Google's consent screen, then copy the code it returns

copilot.title: GitHub Copilot
copilot.body: Uses your Copilot plan. Start, enter the code on GitHub, approve, then finish here. Needs an active Copilot seat. Chat-type jobs only: it cannot read PDFs or index documents.

claude.title: Claude Pro or Max
claude.body: Uses your Claude plan. Open the link, approve, then paste the code Claude shows (it looks like code#state). Codes work once and expire within minutes. Chat-type jobs only: it cannot read PDFs or index documents.

account.deleteBody: This deletes your account and everything in it: documents and their files, knowledge bases, conversations, questions, notes, mastery paths and your learning loop. Your Google Drive and Gemini grants are revoked at Google. Keys you pasted are deleted here; revoke them with their provider too if you no longer want them to exist. A ChatGPT subscription connection is deleted here too, but OpenAI offers no way for AnyLearn to revoke its token, so sign out of ChatGPT on your devices if you want it ended at OpenAI. This cannot be undone.

githubToken.hint: A GitHub token is only for importing private repositories into a knowledge base. Make a fine-grained token with read-only access to Contents, choose “github” above, and paste it. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.

zoteroKey.hint: A Zotero key lets you add items from your own library to a knowledge base, and lets research search it. Create a read-only key at zotero.org/settings/keys (allow library access, and file access for PDFs); the same page shows your numeric user ID.
zoteroKey.userHint: The number zotero.org/settings/keys shows as "Your user ID for use in API calls".

youtubeDataKey.hint: A YouTube Data API key lets a YouTube playlist in a knowledge base list all its videos (up to 500) instead of the latest 15. Make a key for the YouTube Data API v3 in Google Cloud, choose “youtube_data” above, and paste it. AnyLearn uses it only from its server; it is stored encrypted and never shown again.

calendar.fetched: Last read by a calendar app:
calendar.neverFetched: No calendar app has read it yet.
calendar.rotateBody: The current URL stops working at once, in every calendar that uses it. Add the new one where you want it.

email.title: Email in
email.lead: Mail sent or forwarded to this address becomes documents: the message itself and its attachments. AnyLearn never reads your inbox; you choose what to forward.
email.off: Email in is not set up on this server yet.
email.targetDefault: Study inbox (created with the first message)
email.gmail1: In Gmail, open Settings, then Forwarding and POP/IMAP.
email.gmail2: Choose Add a forwarding address and paste your AnyLearn address.
email.gmail3: Gmail sends a confirmation here. Its code appears on this card; enter it in Gmail.
email.gmail4: Create a filter (for example, from your teacher or a newsletter) and choose Forward it to your AnyLearn address.
email.confirmTitle: Gmail is asking to confirm forwarding
email.rotateBody: Mail to the current address bounces from now on. Update your Gmail forwarding to the new one.
email.limits: Up to 50 messages a day, each up to 25 MB. Attachments of a type AnyLearn cannot read are skipped.

workspace.title: Google Forms and Sheets
workspace.lead: These use the Google Drive permission you already gave. AnyLearn opens only the form or sheet you pick.
workspace.importForm: Import a quiz from Google Forms
workspace.exportForm: Turn this Quiz into a Google Form
workspace.importedHint: Skipped questions are those Quiz cannot mark the same way: several right answers, grids, scales, uploads, or no answer key.
workspace.exported: A graded form with {{count}} questions is in your Google Drive.
workspace.noLanguages: Add a language you study first.
workspace.sheetRows: {{name}}: {{total}} rows. The first sheet is read.
workspace.header: The first row is a header
workspace.wordsImported: {{created}} words added, {{duplicates}} already saved, {{invalid}} rows without a word or a meaning.
workspace.wordsPaced: New words come up a few a day, from {{first}} to {{last}}.

errors.failed: The Google Picker could not open. Try again.
errors.nothing_to_import: That form has no question with an answer key Quiz can mark.
errors.nothing_to_export: This knowledge base has no question a form can hold yet.
errors.api_disabled: Google Forms is not enabled on this server yet.
errors.not_a_sheet: That file is not a Google Sheet.
errors.not_found: Google did not let AnyLearn open that file. Pick it again.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.

gcal.title: Write it into Google Calendar directly
gcal.body: A calendar of AnyLearn's own in your Google Calendar, updated every hour, with today's review titled by how much is due. Your other calendars stay unread. Use this or the URL above, not both, or events appear twice.
gcal.pending: Waiting for Google to approve AnyLearn's calendar permission.
gcal.stopBody: AnyLearn stops updating the calendar. You can keep it as it is, or delete it from your Google Calendar.

errors.api_disabled: Google Calendar is not enabled on this server yet.
errors.google_failed: Google Calendar did not accept the change. Try again.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.

classroom.title: Google Classroom
classroom.lead: Each class becomes a knowledge base of its own. Choose what to bring in; AnyLearn lists what is new each day and imports nothing on its own.
classroom.pending: Waiting for Google to approve AnyLearn's Classroom permission.
classroom.needsGoogle: Connect Google on Learning apps first.
classroom.noClasses: No active classes in this Google account.
classroom.noItems: This class has nothing to import yet.
classroom.driveNext_one: {{count}} Drive file needs your confirmation in Google's picker.
classroom.driveNext_other: {{count}} Drive files need your confirmation in Google's picker.
classroom.blockedTitle: Your school has not allowed AnyLearn yet
classroom.blockedBody: School Google accounts, and accounts of students under 18 in particular, can use only the apps the school's Google administrator allows. Ask them to:
classroom.blocked1: Open the Google Admin console, then Security, API controls, App access control.
classroom.blocked2: Find AnyLearn (configure a new app, search by name or by its client ID).
classroom.blocked3: Set it to Trusted or Limited for your students' organisational unit.

errors.api_disabled: Google Classroom is not enabled on this server yet.
errors.google_failed: Google Classroom did not answer as expected. Try again.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.

notebooklm.doneTitle: It is in your Google Drive
notebooklm.doneBody: "{{name}}" is a Google Doc in the folder AnyLearn for NotebookLM.
notebooklm.step1: Open NotebookLM and choose a notebook, or create one.
notebooklm.step2: Choose Add source, then Google Drive.
notebooklm.step3: Open the folder AnyLearn for NotebookLM and pick the doc.

media.title: YouTube and Google Photos
media.lead: A YouTube playlist becomes a course: its videos, in order, as link documents. Photos of notes and boards in Google Photos become page photos.
media.playlistHint: A link with list= in it, from YouTube's Share button.
media.truncated: Only the first 200 videos are listed.
media.added: {{added}} videos added to the knowledge base; their transcripts are fetched in the background.
media.photosOff: Turn on Google Photos in the Google section above.
media.photosPending: Waiting for Google to approve AnyLearn's Photos permission.
media.picking: Pick the photos in Google's window, then choose Done. This page waits for it.
media.photosAdded_one: {{count}} photo added as a page photo.
media.photosAdded_other: {{count}} photos added as one document, a page each.

errors.not_a_playlist: That link has no playlist in it.
errors.unavailable: That playlist is private, deleted or empty.
errors.youtube_failed: YouTube could not be reached. Try again.
errors.api_disabled: Google Photos is not enabled on this server yet.
errors.session_gone: That picking session ended. Start again.
errors.popup: Your browser blocked Google's window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.

send.label: Send to…
send.failed: That did not work. Try again.
send.noParent: Share a page with AnyLearn in Notion first; the export goes under it.
send.canvaBody: "{{name}}" is a Canva Doc. In Canva you can turn it into slides or a poster.
send.notionBody: "{{name}}" is a new page under the page you shared with AnyLearn.

app.disconnectBody: AnyLearn forgets the connection and asks {{app}} to revoke it. What you already imported stays.

notice.denied: {{app}} was not connected: the permission was declined.
notice.failed: {{app}} could not be connected. Try again.
notice.unavailable: {{app}} is not set up on this server yet.

canva.title: Canva
canva.lead: Bring a Canva design (slides, an infographic, a poster) into a knowledge base as a PDF, and open AnyLearn's notes and worksheets in Canva from their "Send to".menu.
canva.pending: Canva reviews public integrations before anyone can connect; until then only test accounts can.

notion.title: Notion
notion.lead: Notion asks which pages to share with AnyLearn when you connect. Those pages and databases become documents and are imported again when they change; notes go back to Notion from their "Send to".menu.
notion.noPages: Nothing is shared yet. In Notion, open a page, choose Connections, and add AnyLearn.
